thread:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a practical backward-compat plan for v2 API (chat, embeddings, rerank, tools). Goal: opt-in v2, minimal breakage.
Ravi: Agree. Keep existing /v1/* routes; introduce /v2/* endpoints and an "x-rw-api-version" header. No silent breakage.
Lena: Draft endpoint names: POST /v2/chat.completions, POST /v2/embeddings, POST /v2/rerank
Lena: Example curl:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-rw-api-version: 2" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/chat.completions
Ravi: Need a compatibility layer that maps common param aliases (e.g., temp -> temperature), and auto-transforms streaming envelopes when possible.
Chris: SDKs: ship patch that defaults to v1 but exposes a single flag to opt into v2. Provide a one-line example in README.
Diego: Question — Dedicated/private customers who have pinned v1: will they be auto-migrated?
Ravi: No. Hosted customers can opt-in or be canaried. Dedicated/private stay on v1 unless customer requests migration.
Lena: Proposed breaking-change list (draft):
- Streaming envelope: metadata moves to top-level token events
- Function calling: rename "params" -> "arguments" and enforce schema for arguments
- Structured outputs: enforce JSON schema for tool outputs (strict parsing)
Natasha: Legal: need deprecation cadence in TOS + 6mo notice email. For enterprise contracts, allow opt-out of scheduled shutdowns.
Sofia: Launch criteria (suggestion):
- Migration guides and API diff docs
- SDKs and examples updated
- E2E tests covering top 25 customer prompts
- Latency parity: 95th percentile within +10ms of v1
- Canary + automatic fallback to v1 on regressions
Ravi: Rollout plan: tenant-level feature-flag. Canary 5% traffic -> 20% after 2w -> 50% after 6w -> full after 12w if stable. Auto-fallback when error-rate > threshold.
Chris: I'll build a small CLI helper: `rw-migrate --check` that scans repos for v1 usage and emits patch suggestions.
Diego: Customer success needs a single-page checklist with estimated effort (low/med/high) per integration type.
Lena: Migration guide outline: mapping table for param renames, streaming transforms, function-calling examples, embeddings compatibility notes, JSONL test harness of canonical prompts.
Maya: Draft deprecation timeline:
- Today: announce v2 as opt-in
- 6 months: console/SDK defaults nudge toward v2
- 9 months: soft deprecation headers on v1
- 12 months: v1 in maintenance mode; final shutdown targeted after 18 months (exceptions possible)
Natasha: Add explicit calendar dates to announcement and clear rollback steps.
Ravi: Engineering tasks: compat mapping layer, regression suite, rollout automation, delta dashboards for latency/cost/quality. Rough estimate: ~6 sprints across teams.
Sofia: Prioritize customer-driven migrations and fixes first. If regressions impact top customers, pause rollout immediately.
Chris: Docs checklist: quickstart, migration guide, API diff examples, SDK changelog, structured-output samples, function-calling snippets.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: api-gateway/v2-toggle @ 1718501800
Maya: Action items:
- Ravi: prototype compat layer by EOW
- Lena: publish migration draft + breaking-changes doc
- Chris: CLI + SDK release plan
- Diego: prepare CS one-pager + FAQ
- Natasha: draft legal email copy with dates
I'll book a follow-up sync next week. :calendar:
